steps.label: 2163-deploy-select-devservice-local-only
command: (() => {const m=document.querySelector('#deployModal.show');if(!m||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089216')throw Error('Own QA deploy dialog only');const e=m.querySelector('[name=deployTargets][value=DEVSERVICE]');if(e.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Target disabled');e.click();return {targets:[...m.querySelectorAll('[name=deployTargets]')].map(e=>({value:e.value,checked:e.checked,disabled:e.matches(':disabled')})),confirmDisabled:m.querySelector('[data-action-ok]').matches(':disabled'),notice:m.querySelector('#deployRedeployNotice').innerText,noticeVisible:!m.querySelector('#deployRedeployNotice').classList.contains('d-none'),submitted:false};})()
